page.overview:
Who is Shiva-Ixion?

Shiva-Ixion is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy. She is shown being summoned by Snow in the Windswept Mire.

In the Maxima version, she was made into an imprismable Mirage, found in the "Hot Under the Collar" match at the Coliseum.
